purpose: economical no-model packing technique screen before any reader campaign

selection_policy.cases: six cap-sensitive scored cases spanning every question type, four exact-abstention sentinels including both known cap regressions, and two stable scored controls
selection_policy.promotion_use: technique selection only; never an efficacy or SOTA claim

selection_rule: maximize scored hit_at_10, then abstention_correct, then minimize packed tokens; reject any arm with a stable-control regression
